name: adversarial-test
description: Adversarial testing discipline for real application surfaces: isolated baselines, invariant-driven attack storms, preserved failures, regression-first fixes, live verification, and machine-readable reports.

interface.shortDescription: Break real workflows and harden the failures.
interface.longDescription: Attack real application paths through isolated, invariant-driven test storms; preserve failures as deterministic regressions; verify authorized fixes live; and productize stable attacks as reported workflow nodes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $adversarial-test to attack this feature through its real user path, preserve every failure, and turn stable cases into a repeatable reported storm.
